text: {"kind":"final","content":"{\"answer\":\"The data for email orders shows these causes (the five: incomplete address, order after the cut-off, non-nearest warehouse, carrier lane, route detour) with counts and late rates:\\n- Incomplete address at intake: 4250 deliveries, late rate 63.6%.\\n- Same-day order after 8am cut-off: 1228 deliveries, late rate 51.3%.\\n- Shipped from a non-nearest warehouse: 1798 deliveries, late rate 42.0%.\\n- Nearest warehouse out of stock: 1610 deliveries, late rate 42.2%.\\n- Nearest warehouse skipped despite stock: 188 deliveries, late rate 39.9%.\\n- Bad carrier lane or D on a Friday: 2762 deliveries, late rate 37.1%.\\n  - Bad carrier lane: 2180 deliveries, late rate 37.7%.\\n  - Carrier D on a Friday: 1183 deliveries, late rate 35.4%.\\n- Route >20% over plan: 776 deliveries, late rate 52.8%.\\n- None of the five: 6406 deliveries, late rate 0.0%.\",\"refused\":false}"}
